policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="m365RequestBody" value="@{
            var raw = context.Request.Body.As(preserveContent: true);
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(raw))
            {
            	return new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject();
            }
            return Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject.Parse(raw);
		}" />
        @{
            var body = (Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject)context.Variables["m365RequestBody"];

            var sessionId = (string)context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-session-id", "");
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sessionId)) {
                sessionId = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-conversation-id", "");
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sessionId)) {
                sessionId = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-ms-client-session-id", "");
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sessionId)) {
                sessionId = (string)body["session_id"];
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sessionId)) {
                sessionId = (string)body["conversation_id"];
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sessionId)) {
                sessionId = (string)body["thread_id"];
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sessionId)) {
                sessionId = (string)body["client_tracking_id"];
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sessionId)) {
                sessionId = (string)context.RequestId.ToString();
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(sessionId)) {
                sessionId = $"new_{Guid.NewGuid()}";
            }
            var userQuery = (string)body["question"];
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userQuery)) {
                userQuery = (string)body["user_query"];
            }
            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(userQuery)) {
                userQuery = (string)body["input"];
            }
            var transformed = new Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject
            {
            	["session_id"] = sessionId,
            	["user_query"] = userQuery
            };
            return transformed.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
		}
        
            application/json
